title: 第2章  葬天棺
content_zh:
带着复仇的渴望，陆烬心神一动，古朴的青铜色葬天棺闪现眼前。
虽对葬天棺了解不多，但因血脉认主，基本用法还是能轻松驾驭。
可下一瞬间，他直接原地消失，再次出现，已经进入一片遍布玄光的空间中。
视线尽头，一座巨大棺椁悬浮虚空，其上弥漫着古老而厚重的气息，黑沉沉有着难以形容的压迫感。
在那棺椁之上，两个金色大字宛若金龙狂舞：
“这便是九绝天棺之一的葬天棺么？”
陆烬强压心头震撼，想要继续探查，却发现自己的实力太弱，一道探查灵气发出，顿时销声匿迹，连个浪花都没泛起。
他无奈叹了口气，旋即想起青莲女帝的话：
“以蕴含灵气之物供之，那，就供你灵石一试！”
他眨眼出了这片空间，旋即轻轻摩挲指间纳戒，一枚灵石飞出，眨眼没入葬天棺内。
青铜小棺玄光一闪，顿时一股精纯灵力涌入体内，眨眼成了他的能量源泉！
“嗯？这便是葬天棺的反哺之力？”
陆烬一惊！
他清晰感受到，当这股灵力涌入体内的那一瞬，他的境界都微微提升了一些！
虽微乎其微，可那股变强的感觉却十分清晰！
“这好像不是灵气，而是灵力！是可以直接加持肉身而被调用的灵力！”
“看来，灵石能在葬天棺的炼化下，成为提升修为的最根本能量源泉！”
诸如灵石灵丹之类的修行辅助之物，都需修炼者对其进行一番炼化之后再吸收。
而经过这葬天棺炼化之后的灵力，却能直接与身体融合，变成身体本源力量！
这无疑让他的修行速度遥遥领先，普通修士望尘莫及！

“既然如此，那……”
陆烬看向手中的纳戒，这里面，有他师尊留给他的所有资源。
那可是他一辈子的积蓄！
作为万剑宗九大峰主之一，虽然他一生只收了陆烬一个徒弟，却是个厉害角色，曾以一人之力杀得方圆千里邪修销声匿迹，战力更是排在万剑宗前三甲！
如此强者，一辈子的积蓄相当可观，陆烬粗略算了一下，除却两万灵石之外，还有一堆功法，兵器，灵材灵药！
这么想着，心神一动，纳戒中，一百灵石飞出。
葬天棺骤然爆发一片白光，将一百灵石直接笼罩，不过呼吸间，全部吞没！
紧接着，一股磅礴灵力再次从葬天棺内冲出，钻入体内，涌向四肢百骸。
一瞬间，陆烬双眼圆睁，一阵针扎般的痛苦直刺天灵盖！
那灵力虽精纯，却在撕扯他的肉身！
一枚灵石所提供的灵力并没有引起疼痛，可百枚灵石所供灵力陡增百倍，他的肉身想要承受，也必须发生蜕变！
不过随着陆烬盘膝运功，这股疼痛没有持续多久就消失了。
“欲戴其冠，必承其重！”
“葬天棺神通广大，我的血肉之躯也必须跟上。”
“吃的苦中苦，方为人上人！而且相对于修为的提升，这点苦又算什么！”
“再来！”
这一次，三百灵石飞了出来！
这可相当于万剑宗内门弟子一年所领灵石总和！
按他的估计，当这三百灵石全部吸收后，他应该能晋入灵珠境！
玄光爆发，嗡鸣不绝！

葬天棺内灵力涌出，冲入体内，宛若陨石砸入湖中，一石激起千层浪！
相比之前的规模，这次可谓江河奔腾，血脉骨骼甚至发出拔节般的噼啪声，剧痛翻滚而来，全身各处似火焰煅烧，连皮肤都赤红隆起，汗毛乍竖，似能破皮而出！
之前是疼，现在是痛！
陆烬牙关紧咬，双手结印，疯狂运转他所修炼的最高等炼体功法，玄品功法，金刚锻体诀！
功法等级，分为黄，玄，地，天，皇，帝品……每个等级有有着上乘下乘之别。
金刚锻体诀乃玄品上乘功法，万剑宗内门弟子需做出巨大贡献之后才有资格修炼，普通弟子想修炼可谓难如登天。
可随着功法运转，葬天棺内却忽然涌出一道奇异白光，白光笼罩下，他体内运转的金刚锻体诀不受控制般，骤然停滞，继而一股磅礴信息涌入脑海！
“嗯？这是葬天棺赠予的功法？它好像对我修炼的金刚锻体诀很嫌弃？”
“大衍化龙诀？不知达到了什么品阶？”
陆烬面色震惊，没想到葬天棺竟然还能反哺功法！
惊喜之余，他立刻开始研究！
这部功法像是直接印刻在脑海，总共分为五个阶段，初阶，中阶，高阶，小成，大成，修炼至大成，肉身可化神龙，上天入海，遨游太虚！
“这品阶比金刚段体诀强太多了！”
既然有了更高阶的功法，他果断舍弃了金刚锻体诀，开始修炼大衍化龙诀！
他要做的就是从基本的初阶开始修炼。
一开始修炼没过多久，体内灵力便如开闸泄洪般呼啸运行起来，陆烬心情控制不住的激动。
“不愧是葬天棺给予的功法！金刚段体决简直垃圾！而且，这还只是刚开始！”
磅礴灵力逐渐被引导调动，淬炼肉身的同时，也彻底被肉身所吸收消化。
他的气息也在不断攀升！
可伴随着修炼，他的肉身也开始发生变化，阵阵剧痛相随而来，持续传遍全身。

陆烬咬紧牙关，痛苦中感受着身体的蜕变，那感觉，犹如在炼狱中脱胎换骨，破茧成蝶……
不知过去多久，当三百灵石被消耗殆尽，剧痛终于消失，他眸色却是一变：
“竟没能晋升？难道与吞噬丹田有关？”
灵珠境，顾名思义，就是将灵气在丹田内凝聚灵珠，一重境界一颗灵珠，修至大成后，九九归一，方可冲击金丹之境！
而吞噬了数百灵石后，竟没能凝聚灵珠，这让陆烬大感意外！
要知道，他上次凝聚一颗灵珠，也不过消耗五十灵石而已。
“既然不够，那就再来！”
他虽修炼心切，却也稳扎稳打，毕竟肉身的强大也需要一个过程，在身体能够承受的痛苦范围内，这一次，他直接动用了五百灵石。
随着修炼深入，血肉之躯对痛苦的承受力也大幅提升，这一次投入五百灵石，他有十足的把握，晋升灵珠境！
剧痛翻来覆去，气息潮汐回荡……
不知过去多久。
轰隆——
戮仙峰上，黑云密布，风起云涌！
不多时，一声惊雷划破天际，滚滚降落。
起初，所有人都以为这只是一场普通的雷雨，直到那霹雳闪电盘绕山巅，久久不散，这才引起了不少人注意。
万剑宗内。
“不对劲！这不是普通雷电，这是雷劫！”
“怎么会是戮仙峰的方向？那山头不是荒废了么？”
“戮仙峰和圣女峰挨着，传闻圣女正闭关冲击金丹境二品，一定是她引发了雷劫！”
“圣女若真能晋升二品金丹，那她就有资格加入方圆万里最大势力，血月圣地！一步登天！”

“杨巅峰师兄曾是万剑宗圣子，现在更是血月圣地赤羽长老座下亲传弟子，他与圣女相互爱慕人尽皆知，有这层关系，进入血月圣地板上钉钉！”
“传出去，我万剑宗柳圣女马上踏入二重金丹境！这般天骄，足以让其他宗门仰慕，忌惮！”
“……”
万剑宗众弟子议论间，一些宗门高层也被这一幕震惊了。
毕竟圣女柳如烟晋升金丹境才不过三个月，现在又要晋升二品，这般天赋，让人望尘莫及！
只是，让所有人想不到的是。
此刻，在圣女峰顶一座修行阵位上，一名正修炼中的女子却忽然喷出一口鲜血，眸色满是愕然。
“竟然……失败了！”
“可我明明引来了雷劫！”
此女，正是万剑宗圣女，柳如烟！
她不可置信的抬起美眸，看向戮仙峰上空，那里雷声轰鸣，雷蛇闪电游走不休，时不时降临下来，却落在戮仙峰上！
“那道雷劫，不是我的？难道还有别人在晋升？”
“戮仙峰早已荒废，不可能有人渡劫！而且……那道雷劫怎么跟金丹劫完全不一样？！”
柳如烟眸色愕然，这时一道沙哑老妪的声音从她指间纳戒传出，竟带着一抹意外：
“居然是灵珠劫！”
柳如烟皱眉：
“狐师，你是说，灵珠境……也能引发雷劫？”
“不错！
修炼本就逆天而行，天地间有更一些惊才绝艳之辈，天赋太过于卓绝引得天道反噬，即便是灵珠境也能引来雷劫！”
柳如烟更是意外，显然没想到，万剑宗内竟有如此天骄。

可下一秒那老妪的声音就激动起来：
“徒儿，快！
这灵珠境的雷劫远比不上金丹境的规模，而以你现在的实力还无法引来金丹雷劫，所以，若能以灵珠境的雷劫提前锤炼肉身，你与至尊骨将会契合得天衣无缝，之后冲击金丹二重，水到渠成！”
“狐师，你的意思是，让我抢夺灵珠雷劫？”
“不错！你修炼为师赐予的大掠夺仙术，就是要掠夺一切资源为己所用！如此机缘造化你若浪费，那就是暴殄天物！”
闻言，柳如烟眸色逐渐赤红，溢满贪婪之光。
“好！”
柳如烟眸色森冷，手中纳戒直接飞出三百灵石，全部打入前方炼石鼎炉内！
“雷来！”
随着炼石鼎炉内灵气涌入体内，她气息节节攀升，一品金丹的气息爆发，灵气化作一道白色光柱，冲天而起，要强抢天雷！
而在她这么做的时候，棺椁中的陆烬，却处于振奋之中。
“哈哈，吞噬这么多灵石，终于凝聚出了第一颗灵珠！”
闭目内观，无尽吞噬丹田深处，一颗灵珠正如微尘悬浮，精纯灵力荡漾扩散，宛若潮汐。
“大衍化龙诀果然厉害！”
“不过，难道因为修炼了这部功法，才招引来了天打雷劈？不应该达到金丹境才会出现雷劫的么？”
陆烬满眼都是愕然，刚在凝聚灵珠的时候，上方不断有雷劈下来，他感觉棺材都要着火了！
可也正因这部武学，他才扛下了所有雷霆之力！
大衍化龙诀练到极致，能以肉眼可见的速度，修复身体的创伤！
哪怕被天地间至刚至阳的雷霆所伤，也不在话下！
葬天棺在手，又有如此逆天功法，他的修行，如虎添翼！

“雷劫么……既然来了，那就更猛烈些吧！”
说完，他心神一动，纳戒之中，两千灵石滚滚涌入葬天棺！
“凝聚一枚灵珠，还远没到达肉身极限！既如此，那就继续！”
陆烬眼神火热，尽是疯狂之色！
而当两千灵石涌入葬天棺内那一瞬！
九天之上，雷云规模陡然激增！
恰在此时，那柳如烟发出的灵气光柱直接将一团雷光招引而下！
轰嗡嗡——
天雷降临，煌煌天威席卷！
原本自信满满的柳如烟，顿时惊骇欲绝！
“师尊！那天雷规模怎么在顷刻间激增？！”
千钧一发，那老妪声音也急切起来：
“快用至尊骨！！！”
content_en:
With the desire for revenge, Lu Jin's mind moved, and the simple bronze burial coffin flashed before his eyes.
Although I don’t know much about the Sky Burial Coffin, I can still easily control its basic usage because of its bloodline.
But in the next moment, he disappeared on the spot and reappeared, having entered a space full of mysterious light.
At the end of the line of sight, a huge coffin was suspended in the void. It was filled with an ancient and heavy atmosphere, and it was dark and had an indescribable sense of oppression.
On the coffin, two large golden characters looked like golden dragons dancing wildly:
"Is this the Sky Burial Coffin, one of the Nine Ultimate Sky Coffins?"
Lu Jin suppressed the shock in his heart and wanted to continue to investigate, but found that his strength was too weak. A burst of exploration spiritual energy was emitted and disappeared immediately without even a wave.
He sighed helplessly, and then remembered the words of Empress Qinglian:
"If you offer it with something that contains spiritual energy, then I will give you the spiritual stone to try!"
He blinked out of this space, and then gently rubbed the ring between his fingers. A spiritual stone flew out and disappeared into the burial coffin in the blink of an eye.
The small bronze coffin flashed with mysterious light, and a stream of pure spiritual power suddenly poured into his body, becoming his source of energy in the blink of an eye!
"Huh? Is this the power of the Sky Burying Coffin to feed back?"
Lu Jin was shocked!
He clearly felt that the moment this spiritual power poured into his body, his realm improved slightly!
Although it's very slight, the feeling of getting stronger is very clear!
"This doesn't seem to be spiritual energy, but spiritual power! It's spiritual power that can be directly used to bless the physical body!"
"It seems that the spiritual stone can become the most fundamental source of energy for improving cultivation through the refining of the Sky Burial Coffin!"
Cultivation aids such as spiritual stones and spiritual elixirs require practitioners to refine them before absorbing them.
However, the spiritual power refined by the Sky Burial Coffin can be directly integrated with the body and become the original power of the body!
This undoubtedly puts his cultivation speed far ahead, beyond the reach of ordinary monks!
"If that's the case, then..."
Lu Jin looked at the Najie in his hand. In it were all the resources left to him by his master.
That is his life savings!
As one of the nine peak masters of the Ten Thousand Swords Sect, although he only had one disciple, Lu Jin, in his life, he was a powerful character. He once killed evil cultivators thousands of miles away with one person, and his combat power ranked among the top three of the Ten Thousand Swords Sect!
For such a powerful person, the lifetime savings are quite considerable. Lu Jin did a rough calculation and found that in addition to 20,000 spiritual stones, there were also a bunch of skills, weapons, spiritual materials and elixirs!
Thinking like this, his mind moved, and a hundred spiritual stones flew out of the ring.
A burst of white light suddenly erupted from the burial coffin, directly covering a hundred spirit stones, and swallowed them all in just one breath!
Immediately afterwards, a majestic spiritual power rushed out of the burial coffin again, penetrated into the body, and surged towards the limbs and bones.
In an instant, Lu Jin's eyes widened, and a burst of pain like needles pierced Tianling Gai!
Although the spiritual power was pure, it was tearing at his physical body!
The spiritual power provided by one spiritual stone did not cause pain, but the spiritual power provided by a hundred spiritual stones suddenly increased a hundred times. His physical body had to undergo transformation if he wanted to bear it!
However, as Lu Jin crossed his legs and performed his exercises, the pain disappeared shortly after.
"If you want to wear its crown, you must bear its weight!"
"The Sky Burial Coffin has great supernatural powers, and my flesh and blood body must also keep up."
"Only by enduring the most hardships can one become a master! And compared to the improvement of one's cultivation, this little bit of hardship is nothing!"
"Come again!"
This time, three hundred spirit stones flew out!
This is equivalent to the total amount of spiritual stones received by the inner disciples of Wanjian Sect in one year!
According to his estimation, after absorbing all three hundred spirit stones, he should be able to advance to the spirit bead realm!
The mysterious light explodes and the buzzing is endless!
The spiritual power surged out of the sky burial coffin and rushed into the body, just like a meteorite smashing into a lake, causing a thousand waves with one stone!
Compared with the previous scale, this time it was like a river rushing, and the blood and bones even made a crackling sound like joints. Severe pain rolled in, and every part of the body was burning like fire.Even the skin was red and swollen, and the hairs stood on end, as if they could break out of the skin!
It hurt before, now it hurts!
Lu Jin clenched his teeth, formed seals with his hands, and frantically operated the most advanced body-training techniques he had practiced, the Xuanpin Kung Fu, and the Vajra Body-Forning Technique!
The levels of Kung Fu are divided into Huang, Xuan, Earth, Heaven, Emperor, Emperor... Each level has its own superior and inferior grades.
The Vajra Body Forging Technique is an advanced technique of Xuanpin. The inner disciples of Wanjian Sect need to make a huge contribution before they are qualified to practice it. For ordinary disciples, it is as difficult as climbing to the sky.
But as the technique was running, a strange white light suddenly emerged from the burial coffin. Under the white light, the Vajra Body Forging Technique running in his body suddenly stopped as if out of control, and then a majestic information poured into his mind!
"Huh? Is this a technique given to me by the Burying Sky Coffin? It seems to dislike the Diamond Body Forging Technique that I practice?"
"Dayan Dragon Transformation Technique? I wonder what level you have reached?"
Lu Jin looked shocked. He didn't expect that the Sky Burial Coffin could teach him skills back!
Surprised, he immediately started researching!
This skill seems to be directly engraved in my mind. It is divided into five stages: primary level, intermediate level, advanced level, small level, and great level. When you practice to great level, your body can transform into a dragon, go up to the sky and into the sea, and travel in Taixu!
"This level is much stronger than the King Kong Duan Ti Jue!"
Now that he had higher-level skills, he decisively gave up the Diamond Body Forging Technique and started practicing the Dayan Transformation Dragon Technique!
All he has to do is start practicing from the basic level.
Not long after he started practicing, the spiritual power in his body started roaring like a flood, and Lu Jin couldn't control his excitement.
"It is worthy of the skills given by the Burying Sky Coffin! The Diamond Duan Tijue is simply rubbish! And this is just the beginning!"
The majestic spiritual power is gradually guided and mobilized. While tempering the physical body, it is also completely absorbed and digested by the physical body.
His aura is also rising!
But as he practiced, his physical body also began to change, and bursts of severe pain followed and continued to spread throughout his body.
Lu Jin gritted his teeth, feeling the transformation of his body in pain. It felt like being reborn in purgatory, breaking out of a cocoon and turning into a butterfly...
I don't know how much time passed, but when the three hundred spirit stones were exhausted and the severe pain finally disappeared, the expression in his eyes changed:
"I didn't get promoted? Is it related to swallowing Dantian?"
The Spiritual Pearl Realm, as the name suggests, is to condense the spiritual energy into spiritual pearls in the Dantian. One spiritual pearl in the first level of the realm. After cultivation to great success, the ninety-nine will return to one, and only then can one hit the golden elixir realm!
After devouring hundreds of spirit stones, he was unable to condense the spirit beads, which surprised Lu Jin!
You know, the last time he condensed a spirit bead, he only consumed fifty spirit stones.
"Since it's not enough, let's do it again!"
Although he was eager to practice, he also practiced steadily. After all, physical strength also requires a process. Within the pain range that the body can bear, this time, he directly used five hundred spirit stones.
As his practice deepened, his flesh and blood body's ability to withstand pain also increased significantly. This time, by investing five hundred spirit stones, he was absolutely sure that he would be promoted to the spirit pearl realm!
Severe pain comes and goes, and the breath echoes with tides...
I don’t know how much time has passed.
Boom——
On the Immortal Slaughter Peak, dark clouds are gathering and the wind is surging!
Not long after, a roar of thunder pierced the sky and rolled down.
At first, everyone thought it was just an ordinary thunderstorm, until the thunder and lightning circled the top of the mountain and lingered for a long time, which attracted the attention of many people.
Within Wanjian Sect.
"Something's wrong! This is not an ordinary thunder and lightning, this is a thunder disaster!"
"How could it be the direction of Immortal Killing Peak? Isn't that mountain top deserted?"
"The Slaughter Immortal Peak and the Saintess Peak are next to each other. It is rumored that the Saintess is retreating to attack the second level of the Golden Core Realm. She must have caused the thunder disaster!"
"If the saint can really be promoted to the second-grade golden elixir, then she will be qualified to join the largest force within thousands of miles, the Blood Moon Holy Land! Reach the sky in one step!"
"Senior Brother Yang Dingfeng was once the holy son of Wanjian Sect, and now he is the descendant of Elder Chiyu of the Blood Moon Holy Land.Disciple, it is well known that he and the Saint are in love with each other. With this kind of relationship, he enters the Blood Moon Holy Floor and nails it! "
"Spread the news that I, Saint Liu of the Wanjian Sect, will immediately enter the second level of the Golden Core Realm! Such a genius is enough to make other sects admire and fear him! "
"..."
While the disciples of Wanjian Sect were discussing, some senior sect officials were also shocked by this scene.
After all, it has only been three months since Saint Liu Ruyan was promoted to the Golden Core Realm, and now she is about to be promoted to the second level. Such a talent is beyond the reach of others!
But, what everyone didn’t expect was.
